## المرحلة 3 — Beats

| Beat | In–Out | Function | Visual | Product | Sound | Shot |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 01 | 0.0–1.5 | Hook | Extreme macro of condensation droplets on matte midnight-blue aluminum, unidentifiable | Indirect (color) | paper rustle | S01 |
| 02 | 1.5–3.0 | Reveal | Camera pulls back: it is the product's cap, real, standing on a paper hill | Direct, partial | soft thud | S02 |
| 03 | 3.0–6.0 | Desire | Macro: one droplet slides down the can and meets the paper | Direct | droplet tick | S03 |
| 04 | 6.0–7.5 | Trigger | The droplet touches the paper; deep teal floods the kraft world outward | Direct | color swell | S04 |
| 05 | 7.5–11.0 | Escalation | Paper hills unfold, houses pop up, the sun pins on: a full world wakes | Direct | paper cascade | S05 |
| 06 | 11.0–11.8 | Silence | Everything holds perfectly still for 0.8s | Direct | near silence | S06 |
| 07 | 11.8–13.0 | Payoff | The world settles golden; the can stands at its center | Full | warm resolve | S07 |
| 08 | 13.0–15.0 | Hero + End Card | The can alone on a calm surface, space reserved lower-left for logo | Full, 0% covered | logo sting | S08 |

## المرحلة 6 — برومبت الصورة (S03)

```
A commercial product still, extreme close-up, 9:16 vertical. the NIMBUS cold brew can, a slim
330ml aluminum can in matte midnight blue with a single thin cream band around the upper third,
a silver pull-tab lid, a small circular cream emblem centered on the band, soft-touch matte
finish with faint condensation, rendered with exact real-world fidelity identical to the
reference image. Framed on the right third and centered in the middle 70% of the vertical frame,
we see only the lower two thirds of the can and the surface it rests on. A single condensation
droplet hangs at the lower edge of the cream band, about to fall. Behind it, a three-layer kraft
paper hill with torn top edge and soft drop shadow fills the lower left, and the upper left stays
empty cream paper. 100mm macro lens, eye level, shallow depth of field. Single warm key from
upper left, thin rim light tracing the can. Calm, tactile, premium.

premium hand-cut paper collage world built from layered colored cardstock, textured craft paper,
and matte construction paper, every element visibly scissor-cut with crisp edges and a slight
paper thickness, layered with soft real drop shadows on a physical tabletop, tactile stop-motion
craft aesthetic, a controlled palette of warm kraft brown, cream, deep teal with one accent color
reserved for the product moment, warm soft directional studio light from the upper left with
gentle paper-fiber texture, THE PRODUCT ITSELF REMAINS A REAL PHOTOGRAPHIC OBJECT with true
materials, reflections and exact label, never converted into paper, sitting physically inside the
paper world and casting a real shadow onto it.

Every element must appear physically hand-made and layered from real materials with visible edges
and soft real shadow separation. Clean, intentional, editorial composition with generous negative
space. NOT digital illustration, NOT cartoon, NOT 3D render, NOT glossy CGI, no gradients, no
clutter, no watermark, no text beyond the specified label. Premium commercial production quality,
9:16, ultra-detailed.

No hands, no people, no faces. No text, no watermark. No changes to the product's shape, colors,
proportions, cap, or label.
```

**فحص:** الجسم ~150 كلمة · LOCK-B حرفيًا · CLOSER حرفيًا · 5 بنود negative · لا وجوه/أيدٍ/نص · داخل المنطقة الآمنة

## المرحلة 6ب — برومبت الفيديو (S03)

```
A 3-second commercial clip, 9:16. Begin exactly on the provided start frame: the lower two thirds
of the NIMBUS cold brew can on a kraft paper hill, a single droplet hanging at the lower edge of
the cream band. Preserve every element. the NIMBUS cold brew can, a slim 330ml aluminum can in
matte midnight blue with a single thin cream band around the upper third, a silver pull-tab lid,
a small circular cream emblem centered on the band, soft-touch matte finish with faint
condensation, rendered with exact real-world fidelity identical to the reference image. At 0–1s
the droplet begins to swell and release; at 1–2s it slides slowly down the matte surface leaving
a thin trail; at 2.5s it reaches the base and hangs for a moment; at 3s it touches the paper and
a small teal stain begins to spread. The camera stays completely locked. The can, the paper hill,
and the empty cream area stay perfectly still; nothing else moves. Stop-motion cadence, stepped
easing, 2-3 frame holds, the hand-made "on twos" feel, never smooth CGI motion. End with the
droplet absorbed into the paper and a small teal stain spreading outward, matching the provided
end frame. Audio: a single soft droplet tick, faint paper grain, room tone; no music, no voice.
No morphing, no new objects, no camera shake, no cuts, no text.
```
